player_prompt.intro:
Kai ngana Player {player_id} ngana koro Checkers kadi {color}.
Koro kai wuroma cikin notation [fileRank fileRank], misali '[b2c3]' (harafin ginshi a–h, lamban safu 0–7).
Kawarori koro:
  • Yi motsa cikin diagonal zuwa gaba da 1 idan babu.
  • Kama wanda ya adawa ta hanyar tsallakewa.
  • Wani koro ya Sarki idan ya kai karshen gaba.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kadi woni formatirɛ koŋ. Si [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Red dǝ cidi ba. Blackye kǝnasarzǝna!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Black dǝ cidi ba. Red ye kǝnasarzǝna!
